title.zh: 授予 Transport Contractors，Inc. 在菲律宾境内建设、维护和运营私人固定点对点、陆基与陆上移动无线电台的临时许可的法案
title.en: An Act Granting Transport Contractors, Inc. a Temporary Permit to Construct, Maintain and Operate Private Fixed Point-to-Point and Land-Based and Land-Mobile Radio Stations for the Reception and Transmission of Radio Communications Within the Philippines
title.orig: An Act Granting Transport Contractors, Inc. a Temporary Permit to Construct, Maintain and Operate Private Fixed Point-to-Point and Land-Based and Land-Mobile Radio Stations for the Reception and Transmission of Radio Communications Within the Philippines
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp giấy phép tạm thời cho Transport Contractors, Inc. để xây dựng, duy trì và vận hành trạm vô tuyến cố định điểm-điểm, trên mặt đất và di động mặt đất tư nhân để nhận và truyền thông tin vô tuyến tại Philippines
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้ใบอนุญาตชั่วคราวแก่ Transport Contractors, Inc. ในการก่อสร้าง บำรุงรักษา และดำเนินการสถานีวิทยุแบบจุดต่อจุดประจำที่、ภาคพื้นดินและเคลื่อนที่ภาคพื้นดินของเอกชนสำหรับรับและส่งการสื่อสารทางวิทยุในฟิลิปปินส์
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan izin sementara kepada Transport Contractors, Inc. untuk membangun, memelihara, dan mengoperasikan stasiun radio titik-ke-titik tetap, berbasis darat dan mudah alih darat swasta untuk penerimaan dan pengiriman komunikasi radio di Filipina
title.ms: Akta memberikan permit sementara kepada Transport Contractors, Inc. untuk membina, menyelenggarakan dan mengendalikan stesen radio titik-ke-titik tetap, berasas darat dan mudah alih darat persendirian untuk penerimaan dan penghantaran komunikasi radio di Filipina

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 11 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_5009_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby granted to Transport Contractors, Inc., its successors or assigns, a temporary permit to construct, maintain and operate in the Philippines, at Manila and at such places as the said corporation may select, subject to the approval of the Secretary of Public Works and Communications, private fixed point-to-point and land-based and land-mobile radio stations for the reception and transmission of wireless messages on radiotelegraphy and radiotelephony, each station to be provided with a radio transmitting apparatus and a radio receiving apparatus.

This temporary permit shall continue to be in force during the time that the Government has not established similar service at the places selected by the grantee, and is granted upon the express condition that the same shall be void unless the construction or installation of said stations be begun within one year from the date of the approval of this Act and be completed within two years from said date.

The grantee, its successors or assigns, shall not engage in domestic business of telecommunications in the Philippines without further special assent of the Congress of the Philippines, it being understood that the purpose of this temporary permit is to secure the grantee the right to construct, install, maintain and operate private fixed point-to-point and land-based and land-mobile radio stations in such places within the Philippines as the interest of the grantee may justify, as well as to enable it to better serve the public in the dissemination of news and events of national interest.
No fees shall be charged by the grantee as the radio stations that may be established by virtue of this Act shall engage in communications regarding the grantee’s business only.
The grantee, its successors or assigns, shall so construct and operate its radio stations as not to interfere with the operation of other radio stations maintained and operated in the Philippines.

The grantee, its successors or assigns, shall hold the national, provincial, city and municipal governments of the Philippines harmless from all claims, accounts, demands, or action arising out of accidents or injuries, whether to property or to persons, caused by the construction or operation of its radio stations.
The grantee, its successors or assigns, shall be subject to the corporation laws of the Philippines now existing or hereafter enacted.

The grantee, its successors or assigns, is authorized to operate its private fixed point-to-point and land-based and land-mobile radio stations in the medium frequency, high frequency, and very high frequency that may be assigned to it by the Secretary of Public Works and Communications.

A special right is hereby reserved to the President of the Philippines in time of war, insurrection, public peril, calamity or disaster to cause the closing of the grantee’s radio stations or to authorize the temporary use or possession thereof by any department of the Government upon its just compensation.

This temporary permit shall be subject to amendment, alteration, or repeal by the Congress of the Philippines when the public interest so requires, and shall not be interpreted as an exclusive grant of the privilege herein provided for.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
